name: procedure_pseudo_code
title: Procedure Pseudo Code
description: Decompile one analyzed procedure by symbol name or provider-normalized address. Returns provider-specific pseudocode, never original source or cross-provider text equivalence, and may return null; request procedure_assembly when instruction precision matters. Ghidra no-return assumptions may cut the analyzed body; Evidence limitations report observed terminal calls and available callee identities.

document.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

__schema1.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

name: analyze_function
title: Analyze Function
description: Build a dossier for one native function identified by symbol or provider-returned address. Returns identity with complete inclusive analyzed body ranges or explicit unknown, provider-specific pseudocode and assembly, comments, calls, references, referenced strings/names, local CFG blocks, and available native API boundary observations. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in limitations with available callee identities.

stack_displacement.description: Observed signed stack byte displacement, encoded as decimal to preserve precision.

provider_value.description: Original provider display text, which may shorten the typed object.

decoding.description: When present, value retains native display text because typed bytes could not be decoded.

encoding_status.description: Whether the provider declares the encoding or REA infers it from the typed bytes and native display. This does not establish the original source's intended encoding.

end.description: Inclusive last address of this observed body range.

name: open_binary
title: Open Binary
description: Open a local executable, application bundle, archive, JavaScript, source map, plist, or analysis database after validation. format=dos-com explicitly interprets 1..65280 headerless bytes as a DOS COM analysis image; omission preserves header-based detection. provider_id selects one deep provider or deterministic auto selection; the binding remains stable until close or an explicit switch, with no failure fallback. Reopening the same target and profile retains its active database and metadata edits. An optional analysis snapshot is imported atomically and must match the binary identity, concrete provider, and canonical analysis profile exactly; importing into a session with metadata mutations requires closing and reopening it first.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

format.description: Explicit headerless DOS COM interpretation; omission preserves header-based detection

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

__schema0.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

__schema2.description: Explicit headerless DOS COM interpretation; omission preserves header-based detection

__schema5.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

name: close_binary
title: Close Binary
description: Drain earlier provider requests, optionally write a provider-neutral analysis snapshot atomically to the caller-supplied path, then close the active target and every provider resource started for it. Later provider requests wait until this lifecycle operation finishes. Existing files require explicit overwrite; a failed save leaves the session open so cached analysis is not lost. Metadata edits prevent immutable snapshot saves until the session is recreated; export_evidence_bundle preserves mutable observations before closing without a snapshot.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

__schema0.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

evidence_records.description: All retained Evidence records, including observations without replay bindings.

name: binary_session
title: Binary Session
description: Report the complete current target, provider, capability availability, client-feature, analysis, and server-identity status without starting analysis.

expected_package_version.description: Expected package version used to reject stale or mismatched input.

expected_catalog_digest.description: Expected catalog digest used to reject stale or mismatched input.

expected_server_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path expected for the running server; relative paths are rejected.

__schema2.description: Absolute local filesystem path expected for the running server; relative paths are rejected.

name: export_evidence_bundle
title: Export Evidence Bundle
description: Atomically write the session's deterministic Evidence bundle to the requested local path. Existing files require overwrite: true; records and manifests use canonical byte-stable ordering.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the exported evidence bundle; relative paths are rejected.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

__schema0.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the exported evidence bundle; relative paths are rejected.
